rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that someone commits themselves fully to an activity or cause.

example.english: I dedicate myself wholeheartedly to volunteer work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 cyun4 sam1 tau4 jap6 zou6 ji6 gung1

rows.note: Use this when deliberately allocating money, time, or another resource for a special purpose.

example.english: I will dedicate part of my time to volunteering.
example.traditional: 我會撥出一部分時間做義工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 but6 ceot1 jat1 bou6 fan6 si4 gaan3 zou6 ji6 gung1

rows.note: Use this specifically when something is offered or consecrated to a deity for religious purposes.

example.english: We dedicate this sacred object to the deity.
example.traditional: 我哋將呢件聖物奉獻畀神。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 ni1 gin6 sing3 mat6 fung6 hin3 bei2 san4
